project.name: Hillside Deck House
project.description: A two-story hillside home with south-facing decks on both levels, a screened porch, an open spa deck, and a sheltered east entry. Illustrative shell, framing, foundations, and site geometry; not an engineered construction design.

specifications.installation: Flashed sill pan and continuous air seal

type.detail.name: Ledger flashing
type.detail.instructions: Lap the drainage plane over the head flashing; maintain the drainage gap and protect fastener penetrations.

type.house-upper-floor.name: Upper — indoor floor and lower ceiling

specifications.note: Illustrative enclosure only; retained-wall reinforcement, waterproofing and insulation require project-specific design.

type.guard-connection.name: Guard post framing attachment
type.guard-connection.instructions: Connect guard posts to structural rim or edge joists with engineer-specified blocking, connectors and fasteners; do not rely on composite decking for anchorage. Coordinate corner connections and corrosion-compatible hardware with the guard manufacturer.

type.screen-perimeter.name: Screen enclosure perimeter closure
type.screen-perimeter.instructions: Seal screen frame joints continuously at the house, roof underside, deck and corners. Keep insect screening independent of the structural guard. Fit the screen door with perimeter seals, a sweep, self-closing hinges and a latch; verify manufacturer mounting and clearances.
